findings.title: Host runtime evidence is scoped to named paths and does not overclaim full product readiness
findings.evidence: Runtime-map rejects old artifacts as final proof; runtime QA reports name the exact Claude, Cursor, and Codex paths; review pass 11 says host runtime packets allow named runtime paths only and no full plan completion.

findings.title: Debug input/output trace requirement is represented with host-specific limitations
findings.evidence: Claude, Cursor, and Codex adapter/runtime reports include the redacted debug shape 'xiigen <method> : input: <redacted> output: <redacted>' or host-specific evidence refs. Cursor limits this to command return display text, and Codex limits it to codex exec/scripted CLI evidence rather than full plugin chat UI.

findings.title: Parser repair report does not expand Codex runtime claims
findings.evidence: codex-available-skills-parser-repair-report proves only CLI parser/request-boundary repair and explicitly does not prove semantic SkillSelection quality, token savings, trained-model readiness, or full Codex plugin chat UI runtime invocation.

limitations_to_preserve_in_final_reporti: Claude runtime proof is session-only --plugin-dir hook evidence, not persistent marketplace/global installation proof.
Cursor runtime proof is Extension Host command-path evidence; Cursor chat participant UI and screenshot/human UI capture are not proven.
Codex runtime proof is codex exec model-backed scripted evidence invoking the JS CLI adapter; full Codex plugin chat UI is not proven.
Adapter functionality reports are source/component evidence and must not be substituted for full host runtime proof.
Host runtime evidence does not prove token savings, semantic quality, learnability, training, checkpoint readiness, target promotion, rollback safety, or full extension completion.
Debug input/output trace evidence is redacted and host-path-scoped; it must not be described as raw prompt/response display.
final_verdict_rationale: PASS_NO_FIX_NEEDED: reviewed host runtime and adapter reports state what was actually run, preserve Codex full plugin chat UI limitations, and represent the debug input/output trace requirement with host-specific evidence or limitations. No direct overclaim or missing limitation requiring a state/report patch was found.
